verdict.rationale: Vercel ships some event-triggered automations of its own. Git pushes trigger deployments, webhooks can trigger a deployment when a specific event occurs, and firewall custom rules act automatically on incoming traffic. Platform events are also delivered as outbound webhooks for external consumers to act on. However, there is no documented general-purpose rule builder where a user defines arbitrary event→action rules; Workflows' event waiting is a developer building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a general user-defined event→action rules engine, a catalog of configurable actions beyond deploy/block, conditional rule logic, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Webhooks configured with Vercel can trigger a deployment when a specific event occurs.
Connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket to deploy on every push, with a preview URL for every branch.
Block attacks, scrapers, and unwanted traffic with custom rules, IP blocking, and managed rulesets.
